item.title: Boom Technology
item.description: Boom Technology, Inc. (trade name Boom Supersonic) is an American company developing the Overture, a proposed supersonic airliner. It has also flight tested the Boom XB-1, which broke the sound barrier for the first time on January 28, 2025, during a flight from the Mojave Air and Space Port.
